description: Search official US Federal Register documents (final rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents) by full-text term, agency, document type, and publication date range. Returns document number, title, abstract, type, agencies, and links. Data: federalregister.gov (GPO/NARA), no auth required.

agency_slug.description: Restrict results to one agency, by its slug (e.g. "environmental-protection-agency"). Look up slugs with federalregister.agencies.

publication_date_gte.description: Only documents published on/after this date, format YYYY-MM-DD.

publication_date_lte.description: Only documents published on/before this date, format YYYY-MM-DD.

type.description: Document type: RULE (final rule), PRORULE (proposed rule), NOTICE, or PRESDOCU (presidential document).

name: federalregister.documents.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Federal Register Documents
